finding.title: The code uses fixed-size arrays and allocates memory dynamically. However, there is no check to ensure that the input size does not exceed the allocated memory.
Although the code includes free(a); and free(b); to release allocated memory, there is no error handling for the malloc calls.
The code does not check if malloc returns NULL, which could lead to dereferencing a NULL pointer.

scan_orig.message: Parameter 'a' can be declared as pointer to const
Parameter 'b' can be declared as pointer to const
